name: jailbreaks
one_liner: A public library of prompts designed to bypass the safety rules of various AI chatbots.
buyer: Honestly, nobody legitimate should be paying for this — it's a hobbyist list with no real commercial path, and using it against production AI products can violate those products' terms of service.
business_use_cases: An AI safety researcher or red-teamer references it to understand common failure modes while hardening their own system's guardrails.
A vendor's trust-and-safety team scans it to patch known jailbreak patterns in their own model's defenses.

money_ideas.idea: No legitimate revenue model — a product built around 'jailbreak prompts as a service' invites ToS violations and real legal and reputational risk.

steal_this: Don't build a product around this; at most, use it as a reading list to stress-test your own AI product's safety filters before shipping.
